# API Reference Summary

**Project:** RExA — Explainable Reasoning Analysis of Descriptive Answers
**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8000` (local) — all routes below are relative to
`API_PREFIX` (default `/api`), e.g. `POST /api/auth/login`.
**Interactive docs:** `GET /docs` (Swagger UI), `GET /redoc` (ReDoc) — auto-generated by
FastAPI from the same schemas summarized here; use them for the full, always-accurate
request/response schema and to try requests live.

## Conventions

- **Auth:** every endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` **except**
  `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/register`, and `GET /api/health`.
- **Response envelope:** every response (success or error) has the shape:

  ```json
  { "data": <T | null>, "message": "optional string", "success": true | false }
  ```

- **Pagination:** list endpoints accept `page` (default 1) and `pageSize` (default 20,
  capped at 100) query params, and return:

  ```json
  { "data": [...], "total": 42, "page": 1, "pageSize": 20, "totalPages": 3 }
  ```

- **Roles:** `admin`, `analyst`, `viewer`. Endpoints marked 🔒**admin+analyst** require the
  `require_admin_or_analyst` dependency; endpoints marked 🔒**admin** require `require_admin`.
  All other authenticated endpoints only require a valid token (any role).

---

## Health

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| GET | `/api/health` | none | Returns `{ status, service, model_mode }` — liveness/readiness check |
| GET | `/` | none | Root banner message pointing to `/docs` |

## Auth (`/api/auth`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Body | Description |
|--------|------|------|------|--------------|
| POST | `/api/auth/login` | none | `{ email, password }` | Returns `{ user, token }` on success; `401` on invalid credentials |
| POST | `/api/auth/register` | none | `{ name, email, password, confirmPassword }` | Creates a `viewer`-role account; `409` if email already registered; `422` if passwords don't match |
| GET | `/api/auth/me` | any | – | Returns the current authenticated user's profile |
| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | any | – | No-op (stateless JWT — client discards the token) |

## Questions (`/api/questions`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| GET | `/api/questions` | any | Paginated list; optional `search` (matches title, case-insensitive) |
| POST | `/api/questions` | 🔒admin+analyst | Create `{ title, prompt, reference_answer, concepts[], course? }` |
| GET | `/api/questions/{id}` | any | Fetch a single question; `404` if not found |
| PUT | `/api/questions/{id}` | 🔒admin+analyst | Partial update (only supplied fields are changed) |
| DELETE | `/api/questions/{id}` | 🔒admin+analyst | Deletes the question and cascades to its submissions/analysis runs |

## Analysis (REXA core)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| POST | `/api/analyze` | any | Runs REXA on one student answer. Body: `{ question_id? , question_text?, reference_answer?, concepts?, student_answer, student_name?, save=true }`. Either `question_id` **or** `question_text`+`reference_answer` is required. Returns `{ analysis_id?, submission_id?, question_id?, result }` where `result` is the full `RexaResult` (see §"RexaResult shape" below). |
| GET | `/api/analyses` | any | Paginated analysis history; optional `question_id` filter |
| GET | `/api/analyses/{id}` | any | Fetch a single analysis run (includes the full stored `result_json`) |

## Batch / Compare / Baselines

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| POST | `/api/batch/analyze` | any | Body: `{ question_id? \| question_text+reference_answer, concepts?, answers: [{ student_name?, student_answer }], save=true }`. Runs REXA on every answer; returns a list of `{ analysis_id?, submission_id?, question_id?, student_name?, result }`. |
| POST | `/api/compare` | any | Body: `{ question_id? \| question_text+reference_answer, concepts?, answer_a, answer_b, student_name_a?, student_name_b? }`. Returns `{ result_a, result_b, diff_summary: string[] }` (both full `RexaResult`s plus generated diff sentences). |
| GET | `/api/baselines/evaluate` | any | Optional `question_id` (defaults to the most recently created question). Runs REXA plus Keyword Overlap / TF-IDF (and Embedding, if `sentence-transformers` is installed) against that question's most recent submission (or its reference answer if none exists). Returns `{ question_text, reference_answer, student_answer, rexa_stars, baselines: [{ name, score, predicted_stars, details }] }`. |

## Reports (`/api/reports`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| POST | `/api/reports/{analysis_id}/pdf` | any | Returns a `application/pdf` byte stream (download) summarizing the analysis run |
| GET | `/api/reports/{analysis_id}/markdown` | any | Returns `text/markdown` content for the same report |

## Analytics (`/api/analytics`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| GET | `/api/analytics/dashboard` | any | Returns `{ totalAnalyses, avgStars, totalQuestions, totalSubmissions, recentAnalyses[], coverageTrend[], roleDistribution[] }` aggregated across all analysis runs |

## Annotations (`/api/annotations`)

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| GET | `/api/annotations` | any | Paginated list; optional `submission_id` filter |
| POST | `/api/annotations` | 🔒admin+analyst | Create `{ submission_id, sentence_roles[], concepts_present[], support_pairs[], depth_score?, star_label?, notes? }`; `404` if the submission doesn't exist |
| GET | `/api/annotations/{id}` | any | Fetch a single annotation |
| PUT | `/api/annotations/{id}` | 🔒admin+analyst | Partial update |
| DELETE | `/api/annotations/{id}` | 🔒admin+analyst | Delete an annotation |

## Model Versions (`/api/models`) — admin registry

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|--------------|
| GET | `/api/models` | any | List all registered model versions, most recent first |
| POST | `/api/models` | 🔒admin | Register `{ name, version, description?, metrics_json? }` (created inactive) |
| POST | `/api/models/{id}/activate` | 🔒admin | Deactivates all other versions and marks this one active |
| DELETE | `/api/models/{id}` | 🔒admin | Removes a model version |

## `RexaResult` Shape

The core object returned (embedded) by `/analyze`, `/batch/analyze`, and `/compare`:

```json
{
  "stars": 4.2,
  "dimension_scores": {
    "concept_coverage": 0.83,
    "reasoning_depth": 0.71,
    "support_quality": 0.5,
    "role_structure": 0.75
  },
  "concept_coverage": {
    "covered": ["daughter cells", "DNA replication"],
    "missing": ["chromosomes"],
    "coverage_pct": 66.67,
    "matches": { "daughter cells": ["Mitosis is when a cell divides into two identical daughter cells."] }
  },
  "highlights": [
    { "index": 0, "text": "Mitosis is when a cell divides...", "role": "Claim", "start": 0, "end": 58 }
  ],
  "support_pairs": [
    { "source_index": 0, "target_index": 1, "source_text": "...", "target_text": "...", "relation": "Supports", "cue": "because" }
  ],
  "reasoning_depth": 0.71,
  "explanations": [
    { "type": "coverage", "message": "Covers 2 of 3 required concepts.", "severity": "warning" }
  ],
  "model_version": "heuristic-v1",
  "question_text": "Explain the process of mitosis...",
  "reference_answer": "Mitosis is the process by which...",
  "student_answer": "Mitosis is when a cell divides..."
}
```

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `stars` | float, 1.0–5.0 | Overall rating |
| `dimension_scores` | object | Four 0–1 sub-scores: `concept_coverage`, `reasoning_depth`, `support_quality`, `role_structure` |
| `concept_coverage` | object | `covered[]`, `missing[]`, `coverage_pct` (0–100), `matches` (concept → matching sentence texts) |
| `highlights` | array | One entry per sentence: `index`, `text`, `role` (`Claim`\|`Evidence`\|`Explanation`\|`Conclusion`\|`Other`), `start`/`end` character offsets |
| `support_pairs` | array | One entry per consecutive sentence pair: `source_index`, `target_index`, texts, `relation` (`Supports`\|`Neutral`\|`Contradicts`), `cue` (matched keyword, if any) |
| `reasoning_depth` | float, 0–1 | Duplicate of `dimension_scores.reasoning_depth`, kept top-level for convenience |
| `explanations` | array | `{ type, message, severity }` — `severity` is one of `info`\|`warning`\|`success` |
| `model_version` | string | Currently always `"heuristic-v1"` |

> **Note:** this is the schema returned by the backend (`app/schemas/__init__.py ::
> RexaResult`), which is the authoritative source. See
> `docs/architecture.md` §7 for a note on aligning the frontend's TypeScript types to this
> exact shape.

## Error Responses

All errors (validation, auth, not-found, unhandled exceptions) share the same shape:

```json
{ "data": null, "message": "human readable error", "success": false }
```

| Status | When |
|--------|------|
| 401 | Missing/invalid/expired JWT, or invalid login credentials |
| 403 | Authenticated but insufficient role for the action |
| 404 | Referenced question/submission/analysis/annotation/model not found |
| 409 | Registering with an email that already has an account |
| 422 | Request body fails Pydantic validation (e.g. missing required field, password mismatch, neither `question_id` nor `question_text`+`reference_answer` supplied) |
| 500 | Unhandled server error |

## curl Examples

```bash
# 1. Log in and capture the token
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"analyst@earas.edu","password":"Analyst1234"}' | python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['data']['token'])")

# 2. Run an ad-hoc analysis
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/analyze \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{
        "question_text": "Explain the process of mitosis.",
        "reference_answer": "Mitosis is the process by which a cell divides into two identical daughter cells.",
        "concepts": ["daughter cells", "chromosomes"],
        "student_answer": "Mitosis is when a cell divides into two identical cells because it copies its DNA first.",
        "save": false
      }'
```
